Mandarin cái: Conditional Inference Tree Analysis

Full analysis code and reproducibility report (British English)

21 October 2026

1 About this document

This report contains the complete executable R analysis, directly embedded below. The analysis code has not been replaced by a source() call, and code is shown by default in the rendered HTML. All comments, descriptions and diagnostic messages in the accompanying analysis script are in English, with British spelling where applicable.

Two sets of quantities must be kept separate: holdout performance is obtained from trees trained without the holdout data, whereas the final tree, node-level statistics and leaf composition refer to models refitted on all 2,000 observations.

1.1 How to render the report

  • With run_analysis: false (default), all source code remains visible while the report displays saved results from results_dir; the annotated CSV is not required merely to render the code.
  • With run_analysis: true, the embedded code is executed sequentially and expects 1-2000.csv in the Knit working directory. It saves new outputs to cai_decision_tree_results/ and refits the analysis.
  • If the R Markdown file is stored under code/decision_tree/ but output files reside elsewhere, edit results_dir in the YAML header to the appropriate relative or absolute path.

Corpus passages are not reproduced in this document. Check BCC and CCL redistribution permissions before publishing underlying annotated tokens.

2 Complete decision-tree analysis code

The sections below preserve the order and analytical statements of cai_conditional_inference_tree_IJCL.R. No statistical thresholds, splits, seeds, estimation routines or graphical parameters have been altered in the embedded code.

2.1 01. Packages and user configuration

# =============================================================================
# Clustering and contextual identification of Mandarin cai: decision-tree analysis
# Reproducible code for the International Journal of Corpus Linguistics (IJCL)
# Code availability: [repository URL]
# =============================================================================
#
# Purpose
#   1. Prepare the annotated tokens and create a sentence-grouped holdout split.
#   2. Recode rare predictor levels using training data only.
#   3. Fit and evaluate full and reduced conditional inference trees.
#   4. Refit final trees to all observations after holdout evaluation.
#   5. Export the publication figure and terminal-node diagnostics.
#
# Provenance
#   - Modelling and preprocessing follow the original analysis script.
#   - Figure design follows IJCL_decision_tree_clean_compact_nodes(1).R.
#   - Earlier figure-generation routines have been removed; only the
#   - IJCL clean-compact publication plot remains.
#
# Input
#   1-2000.csv (adjust INPUT_FILE below if stored elsewhere).
#
# Run
#   source("cai_conditional_inference_tree_IJCL.R", encoding = "UTF-8")
#   Or: Rscript cai_conditional_inference_tree_IJCL.R
#
# Important distinction
#   Holdout metrics come from trees fitted to the training partition only.
#   Published tree structures and leaf statistics come from trees refitted
#   to all observations; they are descriptive, not holdout performance measures.
#
# Reproducibility note
#   The original scripts did not include package-version locking. See the
#   session-information file in the output directory for the local environment.
# =============================================================================

options(stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

# 01. Packages and user configuration -----------------------------------------
REQUIRED_PACKAGES <- c("party", "ggplot2")
missing_packages <- REQUIRED_PACKAGES[
  !vapply(REQUIRED_PACKAGES, requireNamespace, logical(1), quietly = TRUE)
]
if (length(missing_packages) > 0L) {
  stop("Install the following R packages first: ",
       paste(missing_packages, collapse = ", "),
       ". Example: install.packages(c(\"party\", \"ggplot2\"))")
}

# Edit only these paths when running the script in another directory.
INPUT_FILE <- "1-2000.csv"
OUTPUT_DIR <- "cai_decision_tree_results"

SEED <- 159L
TEST_SHARE <- 0.20
MIN_LEVEL_N <- 20L
MIN_NONMODAL_N <- 20L
MIN_CRAMER_V <- 0.10
N_CF_TREES <- 400L
N_PERM <- 1L
MUST_KEEP <- character(0)

# The reduced sensitivity set requires BOTH Cramer's V >= .10 and positive
# permutation importance (estimated using training data only).
# It is skipped if it does not differ from the full set.

# Publication figure parameters reproduce the actual IJCL clean-compact script.
# The figure is drawn only for the full model; both fitted model sets still
# receive the complete numerical, node, path and leaf-profile outputs.
SHOW_BRANCH_LABELS <- TRUE
PLOT_SETS <- "full"
FIG_WIDTH_CM <- 18
FIG_HEIGHT_CM <- 30
EDGE_TEXT_SIZE_PUB <- 2.30
INNER_TEXT_SIZE_PUB <- 2.65
LEAF_TEXT_SIZE_PUB <- 2.55
X_STEP <- 1.15
X_OFFSET <- 0.25

# Muted fills and matching borders for predicted sense classes.
CLASS_FILL <- c(
  cai1 = "#D7E2E8",
  cai2 = "#E1EBF0",
  cai3 = "#EAD7D3",
  cai4 = "#EFE0C1",
  cai5 = "#E2CDD1"
)
CLASS_BORDER <- c(
  cai1 = "#365A70",
  cai2 = "#688FA5",
  cai3 = "#A96F68",
  cai4 = "#A97931",
  cai5 = "#823B47"
)

if (!file.exists(INPUT_FILE)) {
  stop("Input CSV not found: ", INPUT_FILE,
       ". Update INPUT_FILE in Section 01 before running.")
}
dir.create(OUTPUT_DIR, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
OUT <- normalizePath(OUTPUT_DIR, mustWork = TRUE)

save_csv <- function(x, filename) {
  utils::write.csv(x, file.path(OUT, filename), row.names = FALSE,
                   fileEncoding = "UTF-8", na = "")
}

2.3 03. Read and validate the input

# 03. Read and validate the input ---------------------------------------------
raw <- utils::read.csv(
  INPUT_FILE,
  fileEncoding = "UTF-8-BOM",
  check.names = FALSE,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
required_cols <- c("source_row_number", "sentence", "cai_sense", PREDICTORS)
missing_cols <- setdiff(required_cols, names(raw))
if (length(missing_cols) > 0L) {
  stop("Missing required columns: ", paste(missing_cols, collapse = ", "))
}

raw[] <- lapply(raw, function(x) trimws(as.character(x)))
if (anyNA(raw[, required_cols, drop = FALSE]) ||
    any(raw[, required_cols, drop = FALSE] == "")) {
  stop("Required columns contain missing or empty values; inspect the CSV.")
}
if (anyDuplicated(raw$source_row_number)) {
  stop("source_row_number must uniquely identify each observation.")
}
if (!identical(sort(unique(raw$cai_sense)), paste0("cai", 1:5))) {
  stop("cai_sense must contain exactly cai1, cai2, cai3, cai4, cai5.")
}
raw$cai_sense <- factor(raw$cai_sense, levels = paste0("cai", 1:5))
if (nrow(raw) != 2000L) {
  warning("The input has ", nrow(raw), " rows rather than 2,000.",
          call. = FALSE)
}
save_csv(as.data.frame(table(Sense = raw$cai_sense)),
         "01_sense_counts.csv")

2.4 04. Grouped, approximately stratified train/holdout split

# 04. Grouped, approximately stratified train/holdout split --------------------
# Entire identical sentence strings are assigned to only one partition.
# As in the original code, a sentence group's stratum is determined by its
# first occurrence. The 20% target is applied to sentence groups, not tokens.
set.seed(SEED)
group_keys <- unique(raw$sentence)
group_sense <- as.character(raw$cai_sense[match(group_keys, raw$sentence)])

test_keys <- unlist(
  lapply(split(group_keys, group_sense), function(keys) {
    sample(keys, size = max(1L, round(length(keys) * TEST_SHARE)))
  }),
  use.names = FALSE
)
test_idx <- raw$sentence %in% test_keys
tr0 <- raw[!test_idx, , drop = FALSE]
te0 <- raw[test_idx, , drop = FALSE]
stopifnot(nrow(tr0) > 0L, nrow(te0) > 0L)
stopifnot(length(intersect(unique(tr0$sentence),
                            unique(te0$sentence))) == 0L)

partition_audit <- as.data.frame(table(
  Partition = ifelse(test_idx, "holdout", "training"),
  Sense = raw$cai_sense
))
save_csv(partition_audit, "01b_partition_counts.csv")

2.5 05. Learn rare-category recoding from training tokens

# 05. Learn rare-category recoding from training tokens -----------------------
maps <- list()
level_rows <- list()
for (v in PREDICTORS) {
  tab <- sort(table(tr0[[v]]), decreasing = TRUE)
  if ("other_rare" %in% names(tab)) {
    stop("The input category 'other_rare' is reserved: ", v)
  }
  maps[[v]] <- names(tab)[tab >= MIN_LEVEL_N]
  level_rows[[v]] <- data.frame(
    Variable = v,
    Level = names(tab),
    N_train = as.integer(tab),
    Proportion_train = as.numeric(tab) / nrow(tr0),
    Recoding = ifelse(names(tab) %in% maps[[v]], names(tab), "other_rare")
  )
}
save_csv(do.call(rbind, level_rows), "02_original_levels_and_recoding.csv")

recode_data <- function(d) {
  out <- d
  for (v in PREDICTORS) {
    z <- ifelse(out[[v]] %in% maps[[v]], out[[v]], "other_rare")
    out[[v]] <- factor(z, levels = c(sort(maps[[v]]), "other_rare"))
  }
  out
}
tr <- recode_data(tr0)
te <- recode_data(te0)
all_data <- recode_data(raw)

2.6 06. Specify the full and reduced predictor sets

# 06. Specify the full and reduced predictor sets ------------------------------
freq_rows <- lapply(PREDICTORS, function(v) {
  counts <- sort(table(tr[[v]]), decreasing = TRUE)
  n_nonmodal <- sum(counts) - max(counts)
  data.frame(
    Variable = v,
    N_nonmodal = as.integer(n_nonmodal),
    Modal_share = as.numeric(max(counts) / sum(counts)),
    N_levels_observed = sum(counts > 0),
    Frequency_pass = n_nonmodal >= MIN_NONMODAL_N && sum(counts > 0) >= 2L
  )
})
frequency_audit <- do.call(rbind, freq_rows)
save_csv(frequency_audit, "02b_frequency_filter_audit.csv")
full_vars <- frequency_audit$Variable[frequency_audit$Frequency_pass]
if (length(full_vars) < 2L) {
  stop("The training-only frequency filter retained fewer than two predictors.")
}

model_data <- function(d, vars) d[, c("cai_sense", vars), drop = FALSE]

cramers_v <- function(y, x) {
  tab <- table(y, x)
  tab <- tab[rowSums(tab) > 0, colSums(tab) > 0, drop = FALSE]
  if (min(dim(tab)) < 2L) return(0)
  chi <- suppressWarnings(stats::chisq.test(tab, correct = FALSE)$statistic)
  as.numeric(sqrt(chi / (sum(tab) * (min(dim(tab)) - 1L))))
}

v_train <- vapply(full_vars, function(v) cramers_v(tr$cai_sense, tr[[v]]),
                  numeric(1))
set.seed(SEED + 1L)
screen_forest <- party::cforest(
  cai_sense ~ .,
  data = model_data(tr, full_vars),
  controls = party::cforest_unbiased(
    mtry = max(2L, floor(sqrt(length(full_vars)))),
    ntree = N_CF_TREES
  )
)
set.seed(SEED + 2L)
importance_full <- party::varimp(
  screen_forest, conditional = FALSE, nperm = N_PERM
)
if (!all(full_vars %in% names(importance_full))) {
  stop("Permutation importance did not cover all full-set predictors.")
}
imp_train <- as.numeric(importance_full[full_vars])
reduced_vars <- full_vars[v_train >= MIN_CRAMER_V & imp_train > 0]
reduced_vars <- unique(c(reduced_vars, intersect(MUST_KEEP, full_vars)))
run_reduced <- length(reduced_vars) >= 2L &&
  !setequal(full_vars, reduced_vars)
if (!run_reduced) {
  warning("The reduced set is too small or identical to the full set; ",
          "only the full model will be run.", call. = FALSE)
}
var_sets <- list(full = full_vars)
if (run_reduced) var_sets$reduced <- reduced_vars

selection_audit <- data.frame(
  Variable = full_vars,
  Cramers_V_train = unname(v_train),
  Permutation_importance_train = imp_train,
  In_full = TRUE,
  In_reduced = full_vars %in% reduced_vars
)
save_csv(selection_audit, "03_variable_selection_audit.csv")
save_csv(data.frame(
  Variable_set = names(var_sets),
  N_variables = vapply(var_sets, length, integer(1)),
  Variables = vapply(var_sets, paste, character(1), collapse = "; ")
), "04_variable_sets_used.csv")

# Preserve the preprocessing specification for supplementary token-level work.
common_full_levels <- do.call(rbind, lapply(full_vars, function(v) {
  data.frame(Variable = v,
             Recoded_level = levels(droplevels(all_data[[v]])))
}))
common_full_recoding <- do.call(rbind, level_rows)
common_full_recoding <- common_full_recoding[
  common_full_recoding$Variable %in% full_vars, , drop = FALSE
]
save_csv(data.frame(Variable = full_vars),
         "04b_COMMON_FULL_VARIABLE_SET.csv")
save_csv(common_full_levels, "04c_COMMON_FULL_RECODED_LEVELS.csv")
save_csv(common_full_recoding, "04d_COMMON_FULL_RECODING_RECIPE.csv")

cat("\nFull predictors:", length(full_vars), "\n")
cat("Reduced predictors selected:", length(reduced_vars), "\n")
cat("Reduced model fitted:", run_reduced, "\n")

2.7 07. Fit training trees and evaluate the untouched holdout

# 07. Fit training trees and evaluate the untouched holdout --------------------
train_trees <- list()
predictions <- data.frame(
  source_row_number = te0$source_row_number,
  sentence = te0$sentence,
  Actual = as.character(te0$cai_sense)
)
for (which_set in names(var_sets)) {
  vars <- var_sets[[which_set]]
  set.seed(SEED + 10L + match(which_set, names(var_sets)))
  train_trees[[which_set]] <- party::ctree(
    cai_sense ~ ., data = model_data(tr, vars)
  )
  predictions[[paste0("Tree_", which_set)]] <- as.character(
    stats::predict(train_trees[[which_set]], newdata = model_data(te, vars))
  )
}
save_csv(predictions, "05_holdout_predictions.csv")

score_tree <- function(actual, predicted, model_name) {
  labels <- levels(raw$cai_sense)
  cm <- table(
    Actual = factor(actual, levels = labels),
    Predicted = factor(predicted, levels = labels)
  )
  save_csv(as.data.frame(cm), paste0("06_confusion_", model_name, ".csv"))
  tp <- diag(cm)
  recall <- ifelse(rowSums(cm) == 0, NA_real_, tp / rowSums(cm))
  precision <- ifelse(colSums(cm) == 0, 0, tp / colSums(cm))
  f1 <- ifelse(precision + recall == 0, 0,
               2 * precision * recall / (precision + recall))
  save_csv(data.frame(
    Sense = labels, N_actual = as.integer(rowSums(cm)),
    Precision = as.numeric(precision), Recall = as.numeric(recall),
    F1 = as.numeric(f1)
  ), paste0("06b_per_sense_", model_name, ".csv"))
  data.frame(
    Model = model_name,
    N_test = length(actual),
    Accuracy = sum(tp) / sum(cm),
    Balanced_accuracy = mean(recall, na.rm = TRUE),
    Macro_F1 = mean(f1, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
}
model_scores <- do.call(rbind, lapply(names(var_sets), function(which_set) {
  score_tree(
    predictions$Actual,
    predictions[[paste0("Tree_", which_set)]],
    paste0("Tree_", which_set)
  )
}))
save_csv(model_scores, "07_holdout_tree_scores.csv")

2.8 08. Refit final, descriptive trees on all observations

# 08. Refit final, descriptive trees on all observations -----------------------
final_trees <- list()
for (which_set in names(var_sets)) {
  set.seed(SEED + 30L + match(which_set, names(var_sets)))
  final_trees[[which_set]] <- party::ctree(
    cai_sense ~ ., data = model_data(all_data, var_sets[[which_set]])
  )
  saveRDS(final_trees[[which_set]],
          file.path(OUT, paste0("10_final_tree_", which_set, ".rds")))
  writeLines(capture.output(print(final_trees[[which_set]])),
             file.path(OUT, paste0("10_final_tree_", which_set, ".txt")))
}

short_var <- function(x) {
  x <- as.character(x)
  if (length(x) == 1L && !is.na(x) && x %in% names(VAR_SHORT)) {
    return(unname(VAR_SHORT[[x]]))
  }
  x
}
short_level <- function(x) {
  x <- as.character(x)
  hit <- !is.na(x) & x %in% names(LEVEL_SHORT)
  x[hit] <- unname(LEVEL_SHORT[x[hit]])
  x
}

# Compact labels show only the first category (up to seven characters).
# This abbreviation is graphical only; CSV paths retain complete levels.
collapse_levels <- function(x, max_show = 1L) {
  x <- short_level(x)
  x <- x[!is.na(x) & nzchar(x)]
  if (length(x) == 0L) return("")
  x <- vapply(x, function(s) {
    if (nchar(s) > 7L) paste0(substr(s, 1L, 6L), ".") else s
  }, character(1))
  if (length(x) <= max_show) {
    return(paste0("{", paste(x, collapse = ", "), "}"))
  }
  paste0("{", paste(x[seq_len(max_show)], collapse = ", "), ",..}")
}

format_p <- function(p) {
  if (length(p) == 0L || is.na(p) || !is.finite(p)) return("")
  if (p < .001) return("p < .001")
  paste0("p = ", formatC(p, digits = 3, format = "f"))
}
get_node_pvalue <- function(node) {
  crit <- node$criterion
  if (is.null(crit)) return(NA_real_)
  if (is.list(crit) && !is.null(crit$maxcriterion)) {
    value <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(crit$maxcriterion[1]))
    if (is.finite(value)) return(max(0, min(1, 1 - value)))
  }
  if (!is.null(names(crit)) && "maxcriterion" %in% names(crit)) {
    value <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(crit["maxcriterion"][1]))
    if (is.finite(value)) return(max(0, min(1, 1 - value)))
  }
  NA_real_
}
get_predicted_class <- function(node, class_levels) {
  pred <- node$prediction
  if (is.null(pred) || length(pred) == 0L) return(NA_character_)
  best <- which.max(pred)
  if (!is.null(names(pred)) && length(names(pred)) >= best &&
      nzchar(names(pred)[best])) return(names(pred)[best])
  if (length(class_levels) >= best) return(class_levels[best])
  NA_character_
}
get_node_n <- function(node) {
  if (!is.null(node$weights)) return(round(sum(node$weights, na.rm = TRUE)))
  NA_integer_
}

# Extract the two partition labels. The full version is for exported paths;
# the abbreviated version is for the compact graphical display.
get_split_labels <- function(ps, abbreviated = TRUE) {
  if (is.null(ps)) return(c("", ""))
  sp <- ps$splitpoint
  if (is.null(sp) || length(sp) == 0L) return(c("", ""))
  if (isTRUE(ps$ordered)) {
    lev <- attr(sp, "levels")
    if (!is.null(lev)) {
      index <- suppressWarnings(as.integer(sp[1]))
      if (!is.na(index) && index >= 1L && index <= length(lev)) {
        cut_value <- if (abbreviated) short_level(lev[index]) else lev[index]
        return(c(paste0("\u2264 ", cut_value), paste0("> ", cut_value)))
      }
    }
    cut_value <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(sp[1]))
    if (is.finite(cut_value)) {
      cut_text <- format(round(cut_value, 3), trim = TRUE)
      return(c(paste0("\u2264 ", cut_text), paste0("> ", cut_text)))
    }
    return(c("", ""))
  }
  lev <- attr(sp, "levels")
  if (is.null(lev) && !is.null(names(sp))) lev <- names(sp)
  if (!is.null(lev) && length(lev) == length(sp)) {
    left_flag <- as.logical(sp)
    left_levels <- lev[left_flag]
    right_levels <- lev[!left_flag]
    if (abbreviated) {
      return(c(collapse_levels(left_levels), collapse_levels(right_levels)))
    }
    return(c(
      paste0("{", paste(left_levels, collapse = ", "), "}"),
      paste0("{", paste(right_levels, collapse = ", "), "}")
    ))
  }
  c("", "")
}

2.10 10. Publication figure: IJCL clean-compact source implementation

# 10. Publication figure: IJCL clean-compact source implementation ------------
# Internal branch labels are hidden, but labels immediately preceding leaves
# are shown. Internal nodes display variables and p-values on separate lines;
# leaf boxes display the predicted class and sample size. No title or legend.
make_node_label <- function(variable, pvalue) {

  var_text <- short_var(variable)
  p_text <- format_p(pvalue)

  if (is.na(p_text) || !nzchar(p_text)) {
    return(var_text)
  }

  # Put the p-value on a second compact line.
  # Since internal branch-level labels are hidden, vertical space is available.
  paste0(
    var_text,
    "\n",
    p_text
  )
}


# ================================================================
# 10. Extract plotting coordinates
# ================================================================

extract_vertical_tree_ijcl_p <- function(
    tree,
    input_names,
    class_levels
) {

  nodes_list <- list()
  edges_list <- list()
  leaf_counter <- 0L


  walk_tree <- function(node, depth = 0L) {

    node_id <- node$nodeID

    # ------------------------------------------------------------
    # Terminal node
    # ------------------------------------------------------------

    if (isTRUE(node$terminal)) {

      leaf_counter <<- leaf_counter + 1L

      pred <- get_predicted_class(
        node,
        class_levels
      )

      nodes_list[[length(nodes_list) + 1L]] <<- data.frame(
        id = node_id,
        depth = depth,
        y = leaf_counter,
        terminal = TRUE,
        variable = NA_character_,
        pvalue = NA_real_,
        pred_class = pred,
        n = get_node_n(node),
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
      )

      return(
        list(
          id = node_id,
          y = leaf_counter
        )
      )
    }

    # ------------------------------------------------------------
    # Internal node
    # ------------------------------------------------------------

    left_child <- walk_tree(
      node$left,
      depth + 1L
    )

    right_child <- walk_tree(
      node$right,
      depth + 1L
    )

    y_position <- mean(
      c(
        left_child$y,
        right_child$y
      )
    )

    variable_id <- node$psplit$variableID

    variable_name <- if (
      !is.null(variable_id) &&
      length(variable_id) >= 1L &&
      variable_id[1L] <= length(input_names)
    ) {
      input_names[variable_id[1L]]
    } else {
      paste0("V", variable_id[1L])
    }

    nodes_list[[length(nodes_list) + 1L]] <<- data.frame(
      id = node_id,
      depth = depth,
      y = y_position,
      terminal = FALSE,
      variable = variable_name,
      pvalue = get_node_pvalue(node),
      pred_class = NA_character_,
      n = get_node_n(node),
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )

    split_labels <- tryCatch(
      get_split_labels(node$psplit, abbreviated = TRUE),
      error = function(e) c("", "")
    )
    full_split_labels <- tryCatch(
      get_split_labels(node$psplit, abbreviated = FALSE),
      error = function(e) c("", "")
    )

    edges_list[[length(edges_list) + 1L]] <<- data.frame(
      from = node_id,
      to = left_child$id,
      branch = "left",
      branch_label = split_labels[1L],
      branch_label_full = full_split_labels[1L],
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )

    edges_list[[length(edges_list) + 1L]] <<- data.frame(
      from = node_id,
      to = right_child$id,
      branch = "right",
      branch_label = split_labels[2L],
      branch_label_full = full_split_labels[2L],
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )

    list(
      id = node_id,
      y = y_position
    )
  }


  # --------------------------------------------------------------
  # Walk tree
  # --------------------------------------------------------------

  walk_tree(
    tree@tree,
    depth = 0L
  )

  nodes_df <- do.call(
    rbind,
    nodes_list
  )

  edges_df <- do.call(
    rbind,
    edges_list
  )


  # --------------------------------------------------------------
  # Vertical direction
  # --------------------------------------------------------------

  max_y <- max(
    nodes_df$y,
    na.rm = TRUE
  )

  nodes_df$y <- max_y + 1 - nodes_df$y

  max_depth <- max(
    nodes_df$depth,
    na.rm = TRUE
  )


  # --------------------------------------------------------------
  # Horizontal positions
  #
  # X_OFFSET prevents left clipping.
  # --------------------------------------------------------------

  nodes_df$x <- nodes_df$depth * X_STEP + X_OFFSET

  nodes_df$x[
    nodes_df$terminal
  ] <- max_depth * X_STEP + X_STEP + X_OFFSET


  # --------------------------------------------------------------
  # COMPACT TWO-LINE internal-node labels with p-values
  # --------------------------------------------------------------

  nodes_df$node_label <- ""

  for (i in which(!nodes_df$terminal)) {

    nodes_df$node_label[i] <- make_node_label(
      nodes_df$variable[i],
      nodes_df$pvalue[i]
    )
  }


  # --------------------------------------------------------------
  # Terminal labels
  # --------------------------------------------------------------

  nodes_df$leaf_label <- ""

  terminal_idx <- which(
    nodes_df$terminal
  )

  nodes_df$leaf_label[
    terminal_idx
  ] <- paste0(
    nodes_df$pred_class[terminal_idx],
    "\n",
    "n=",
    nodes_df$n[terminal_idx]
  )


  # --------------------------------------------------------------
  # Edge coordinates
  # --------------------------------------------------------------

  from_index <- match(
    edges_df$from,
    nodes_df$id
  )

  to_index <- match(
    edges_df$to,
    nodes_df$id
  )

  edges_df$x <- nodes_df$x[
    from_index
  ]

  edges_df$y <- nodes_df$y[
    from_index
  ]

  edges_df$xend <- nodes_df$x[
    to_index
  ]

  edges_df$yend <- nodes_df$y[
    to_index
  ]

  edges_df$xmid <- edges_df$x +
    0.50 * (
      edges_df$xend -
      edges_df$x
    )


  # --------------------------------------------------------------
  # Child type
  # --------------------------------------------------------------

  edges_df$child_terminal <- nodes_df$terminal[
    to_index
  ]


  # --------------------------------------------------------------
  # Original branch-label positions
  # --------------------------------------------------------------

  edges_df$original_label_x <- (
    edges_df$xmid +
    edges_df$xend
  ) / 2

  edges_df$original_label_y <- edges_df$yend


  # --------------------------------------------------------------
  # Final branch-label positions
  #
  # Internal child:
  #      {level}
  #      [node (p)]
  #
  # Terminal child:
  # ------- {level} ------- [caiX / n]
  # --------------------------------------------------------------

  edges_df$label_x <- ifelse(
    edges_df$child_terminal,
    edges_df$original_label_x,
    edges_df$xend
  )

  edges_df$label_y <- ifelse(
    edges_df$child_terminal,
    edges_df$original_label_y,
    edges_df$yend +
      ifelse(edges_df$branch == "left", 0.40, 0.52)
  )

  list(
    nodes = nodes_df,
    edges = edges_df,
    n_leaves = sum(
      nodes_df$terminal
    ),
    max_depth = max_depth
  )
}

2.11 11. Publication plot function

# 11. Publication plot function
# ================================================================

plot_vertical_ctree_ijcl_p <- function(
    tree,
    input_names,
    class_levels,
    show_branch_labels = SHOW_BRANCH_LABELS
) {

  tree_data <- extract_vertical_tree_ijcl_p(
    tree = tree,
    input_names = input_names,
    class_levels = class_levels
  )

  nodes <- tree_data$nodes
  edges <- tree_data$edges


  # --------------------------------------------------------------
  # Tree lines
  # --------------------------------------------------------------

  p <- ggplot2::ggplot() +

    ggplot2::geom_segment(
      data = edges,
      ggplot2::aes(
        x = x,
        y = y,
        xend = xmid,
        yend = y
      ),
      linewidth = 0.30,
      colour = "grey45",
      lineend = "square"
    ) +

    ggplot2::geom_segment(
      data = edges,
      ggplot2::aes(
        x = xmid,
        y = y,
        xend = xmid,
        yend = yend
      ),
      linewidth = 0.30,
      colour = "grey45",
      lineend = "square"
    ) +

    ggplot2::geom_segment(
      data = edges,
      ggplot2::aes(
        x = xmid,
        y = yend,
        xend = xend,
        yend = yend
      ),
      linewidth = 0.30,
      colour = "grey45",
      lineend = "square"
    )


  # --------------------------------------------------------------
  # Branch-level labels
  #
  # CLEAN PUBLICATION VERSION:
  # Hide ALL branch-level labels that lead to another INTERNAL node.
  #
  # Example removed:
  #
  #        {quantitative}
  #        [ref_bound (p < .001)]
  #
  # The grey "{quantitative}" part is NOT drawn.
  #
  # Labels leading directly to TERMINAL nodes are retained:
  #
  # ------- {none} ------- [cai3 / n=369]
  # --------------------------------------------------------------

  if (isTRUE(show_branch_labels)) {

    terminal_label_edges <- edges[
      edges$child_terminal &
        !is.na(edges$branch_label) &
        nzchar(edges$branch_label),
      ,
      drop = FALSE
    ]

    if (nrow(terminal_label_edges) > 0L) {

      p <- p +
        ggplot2::geom_label(
          data = terminal_label_edges,
          ggplot2::aes(
            x = original_label_x,
            y = original_label_y,
            label = branch_label
          ),
          size = EDGE_TEXT_SIZE_PUB,
          colour = "grey38",
          fill = "white",
          label.size = NA,
          label.padding = grid::unit(
            0.020,
            "lines"
          ),
          label.r = grid::unit(
            0,
            "lines"
          ),
          lineheight = 0.86
        )
    }
  }


  # --------------------------------------------------------------
  # Internal nodes
  #
  # TWO COMPACT LINES: variable + p-value
  # --------------------------------------------------------------

  p <- p +
    ggplot2::geom_label(
      data = nodes[
        !nodes$terminal,
        ,
        drop = FALSE
      ],
      ggplot2::aes(
        x = x,
        y = y,
        label = node_label
      ),
      fill = "white",
      colour = "grey15",
      size = INNER_TEXT_SIZE_PUB,
      lineheight = 0.78,
      label.padding = grid::unit(
        0.035,
        "lines"
      ),
      label.r = grid::unit(
        0.012,
        "lines"
      ),
      linewidth = 0.30
    )


  # --------------------------------------------------------------
  # Terminal nodes
  # --------------------------------------------------------------

  terminal_nodes <- nodes[
    nodes$terminal,
    ,
    drop = FALSE
  ]

  p <- p +
    ggplot2::geom_label(
      data = terminal_nodes,
      ggplot2::aes(
        x = x,
        y = y,
        label = leaf_label,
        fill = pred_class,
        colour = pred_class
      ),
      size = LEAF_TEXT_SIZE_PUB,
      fontface = "plain",
      lineheight = 0.82,
      label.padding = grid::unit(
        0.040,
        "lines"
      ),
      label.r = grid::unit(
        0.012,
        "lines"
      ),
      linewidth = 0.38
    ) +

    ggplot2::scale_fill_manual(
      values = CLASS_FILL,
      limits = names(CLASS_FILL),
      breaks = names(CLASS_FILL),
      drop = FALSE,
      guide = "none"
    ) +

    ggplot2::scale_colour_manual(
      values = CLASS_BORDER,
      limits = names(CLASS_BORDER),
      breaks = names(CLASS_BORDER),
      drop = FALSE,
      guide = "none"
    )


  # --------------------------------------------------------------
  # Coordinate expansion
  #
  # Extra LEFT expansion protects the root and leftmost labels.
  # --------------------------------------------------------------

  p <- p +
    ggplot2::scale_x_continuous(
      expand = ggplot2::expansion(
        add = c(
          0.5,
          0.45
        )
      )
    ) +

    ggplot2::scale_y_continuous(
      expand = ggplot2::expansion(
        mult = c(
          0.015,
          0.015
        )
      )
    ) +

    ggplot2::coord_cartesian(
      clip = "off"
    ) +

    # ------------------------------------------------------------
    # Theme
    # ------------------------------------------------------------

    ggplot2::theme_void(
      base_size = 8
    ) +

    ggplot2::theme(
      legend.position = "none",

      # Extra left margin prevents clipping
      plot.margin = ggplot2::margin(
        t = 4,
        r = 8,
        b = 4,
        l = 20,
        unit = "pt"
      )
    )


  list(
    plot = p,
    data = tree_data
  )
}

2.12 12. Recover complete paths and terminal-node composition

# 12. Recover complete paths and terminal-node composition --------------------
# The original script expected 11_full_tree_paths.csv without generating it.
# Paths are now derived directly from the fitted tree, so no external path file
# or previously loaded R objects are necessary.
make_tree_paths <- function(nodes, edges) {
  root_ids <- setdiff(nodes$id, edges$to)
  if (length(root_ids) != 1L) stop("Expected exactly one root node.")
  leaves <- nodes[nodes$terminal, , drop = FALSE]
  root_id <- root_ids[1]
  paths <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(leaves)), function(i) {
    current <- leaves$id[i]
    steps <- character(0)
    while (current != root_id) {
      incoming <- edges[edges$to == current, , drop = FALSE]
      if (nrow(incoming) != 1L) {
        stop("A node must have exactly one incoming edge.")
      }
      parent_var <- nodes$variable[match(incoming$from, nodes$id)]
      branch_text <- incoming$branch_label_full[1]
      # If party supplies no level labels, retain the correct branch direction.
      if (!nzchar(branch_text)) branch_text <- incoming$branch[1]
      steps <- c(paste0(parent_var, " ", branch_text), steps)
      current <- incoming$from[1]
    }
    data.frame(
      leaf_id = leaves$id[i],
      pred_class = leaves$pred_class[i],
      n = leaves$n[i],
      path = paste(steps, collapse = " -> "),
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  })
  do.call(rbind, paths)
}

make_leaf_profile <- function(tree, original_data, paths) {
  leaf_id <- as.integer(party::where(tree))
  pred_class <- as.character(stats::predict(tree, type = "response"))
  if (length(leaf_id) != nrow(original_data) ||
      length(pred_class) != nrow(original_data)) {
    stop("Final-tree assignments do not match the input row count.")
  }
  labels <- levels(original_data$cai_sense)
  obs_counts <- table(
    Leaf = factor(leaf_id, levels = paths$leaf_id),
    Sense = factor(original_data$cai_sense, levels = labels)
  )
  n_leaf <- as.integer(rowSums(obs_counts))
  if (any(n_leaf == 0L) || sum(n_leaf) != nrow(original_data) ||
      any(n_leaf != paths$n)) {
    stop("Leaf IDs or leaf sizes do not agree with the final fitted tree.")
  }
  counts <- unclass(obs_counts)
  dominant_index <- max.col(counts, ties.method = "first")
  dominant_class <- labels[dominant_index]
  dominant_n <- counts[cbind(seq_len(nrow(counts)), dominant_index)]
  sense_total <- colSums(counts)
  predicted_by_leaf <- vapply(paths$leaf_id, function(id) {
    classes <- unique(pred_class[leaf_id == id])
    if (length(classes) != 1L) {
      stop("A terminal node yielded multiple predicted classes.")
    }
    classes
  }, character(1))

  profile <- data.frame(
    paths,
    pred_class_model = predicted_by_leaf,
    dominant_actual_class = dominant_class,
    dominant_n = as.integer(dominant_n),
    purity = as.numeric(dominant_n / n_leaf),
    sense_total = as.integer(sense_total[dominant_index]),
    sense_coverage = as.numeric(dominant_n / sense_total[dominant_index]),
    leaf_share = n_leaf / nrow(original_data),
    prediction_match = paths$pred_class == predicted_by_leaf &
      paths$pred_class == dominant_class,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  for (j in seq_along(labels)) {
    profile[[paste0("n_", labels[j])]] <- as.integer(counts[, j])
  }
  for (j in seq_along(labels)) {
    profile[[paste0("p_", labels[j])]] <- as.numeric(counts[, j] / n_leaf)
  }
  profile <- profile[order(profile$pred_class, -profile$n,
                           -profile$purity), , drop = FALSE]
  rownames(profile) <- NULL
  if (!all(profile$prediction_match)) {
    warning("Some leaf predictions differ from the empirical majority; ",
            "inspect prediction_match.", call. = FALSE)
  }
  profile
}

2.13 13. Export final-tree diagnostics and the publication figure

# 13. Export final-tree diagnostics and the publication figure ------------------
# Diagnostics are exported for every fitted predictor set, independently of
# which predictor set is displayed in the main-text figure.
for (which_set in names(final_trees)) {
  tree_to_plot <- final_trees[[which_set]]
  current_vars <- var_sets[[which_set]]
  tree_data <- extract_vertical_tree_ijcl_p(
    tree = tree_to_plot,
    input_names = current_vars,
    class_levels = levels(all_data$cai_sense)
  )

  # Persist node information, complete branch paths and empirical composition.
  save_csv(tree_data$nodes,
           paste0("08_vertical_tree_nodes_", which_set, ".csv"))
  save_csv(tree_data$edges,
           paste0("09_vertical_tree_edges_", which_set, ".csv"))
  paths <- make_tree_paths(tree_data$nodes, tree_data$edges)
  save_csv(paths, paste0("11_", which_set, "_tree_paths.csv"))
  leaf_profiles <- make_leaf_profile(tree_to_plot, all_data, paths)
  save_csv(leaf_profiles, paste0("12_", which_set, "_leaf_profiles.csv"))

  # Main-text publication graphic: full predictor set only, by default.
  if (which_set %in% PLOT_SETS) {
    publication_result <- plot_vertical_ctree_ijcl_p(
      tree = tree_to_plot,
      input_names = current_vars,
      class_levels = levels(all_data$cai_sense),
      show_branch_labels = SHOW_BRANCH_LABELS
    )
    p <- publication_result$plot

    # Use the exact output basename and figure dimensions of the source plot.
    figure_base <- paste0("Fig_decision_tree_", which_set,
                          "_IJCL_pvalues_clean_compact")
    if (interactive()) print(p)

    ggplot2::ggsave(
      filename = file.path(OUT, paste0(figure_base, ".pdf")),
      plot = p, width = FIG_WIDTH_CM, height = FIG_HEIGHT_CM,
      units = "cm", device = grDevices::cairo_pdf,
      limitsize = FALSE
    )
    ggplot2::ggsave(
      filename = file.path(OUT, paste0(figure_base, ".png")),
      plot = p, width = FIG_WIDTH_CM, height = FIG_HEIGHT_CM,
      units = "cm", dpi = 600, bg = "white", limitsize = FALSE
    )
    ggplot2::ggsave(
      filename = file.path(OUT, paste0(figure_base, ".tiff")),
      plot = p, width = FIG_WIDTH_CM, height = FIG_HEIGHT_CM,
      units = "cm", device = "tiff", dpi = 600,
      compression = "lzw", bg = "white", limitsize = FALSE
    )
    cat("Publication figure exported for:", which_set, "\n")
  }

  cat("Model:", which_set,
      "| predictors:", length(current_vars),
      "| final terminal nodes:", tree_data$n_leaves,
      "| observations:", sum(leaf_profiles$n), "\n")
}

3.5 Full-tree terminal-node composition

Purity and sense coverage below are descriptive statistics for the final refitted tree, not held-out predictive metrics.

leaves <- read_result("12_full_leaf_profiles.csv", check.names = FALSE)
if (!is.null(leaves)) {
  useful_columns <- intersect(
    c("leaf_id", "pred_class", "n", "dominant_actual_class",
      "purity", "sense_coverage", "leaf_share", "prediction_match"),
    names(leaves)
  )
  show_table(leaves[, useful_columns, drop = FALSE],
             "Terminal-node composition and coverage (full refitted tree)",
             digits = 3)
} else {
  cat("Full-tree terminal-node profiles are not available.")
}

3.6 Run environment and reproducibility

cat("R version:", R.version.string, "\n")

  if (requireNamespace(pkg, quietly = TRUE)) {
    cat(pkg, "version:", as.character(utils::packageVersion(pkg)), "\n")
  } else {
    cat(pkg, "is not installed in the current environment.\n")
  }
}
